latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Lightpanda, a next-generation headless browser for AI and automation.

- Built from scratch in Zig, not based on Chromium/WebKit
- Up to 9x faster and uses 16x less memory than Headless Chrome
- Fully compatible with Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) and Puppeteer/Playwright automation
- Includes integrated MCP server for direct AI control (e.g., Claude, Cursor)
- Supports fast HTML/Markdown export, proxy, network interception, Docker deployment, and more
